tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise}1. ch10:10-13↗ prob:killing-vector-field ↗ prob:killing-vector-field-properties Suppose $(M, g)$ is a Riemannian manifold and $X \in \mathfrak {X}(M)$ is a Killing vector field (see Problems 5-22 and 6-24). Show that if $\gamma : [a, b] \to M$ is any geodesic segment, then $X$ restricts to a Jacobi field along $\gamma $. \end{exercise}
